payload.text/html:
Keeper's log, Gull Rock light

Plain text, then bold, italic, underlined, struck, inline code and a link.

Four marks on one run, a bold link and https://gullrock.example/.

Code inside a link: lens.rotate(90); bold code stays code: trim_wick().

Lamp oil is C16H34, the beam reaches 24 miles, and the inner mark wins: raised lowered, lowered raised.

Text colors: gray, brown, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, red.

Highlights: gray, brown, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, red, and a mark with no name.

Every outer mark around red bold and red.

  Two leading spaces, then three   inside a line.

Characters that are Markdown syntax stay text: *stars*, _underscores_, `ticks`, [brackets](not a link), <angle>, a & b, ~~tildes~~, a | pipe and a back\slash.

# not a heading

1. not an ordered item

- not a bullet

> not a quote

מגדלור — منارة

Weather symbols: 🌊 🌬️ ⛈️ and a family 👨‍👩‍👧.
